text:
During a balanced middle, it was good to get your short note; we looked into it and understand that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal booking, the service response at the airport, and the disruption that followed.

We regret that your experience did not reflect the standards we set for travelers and their animals. The Companion Animal Travel Desk reviewed the record, consulted the relevant airport notes, and asked the safety coordinator to confirm whether any preventable hazard or omission affected the journey. Our procedure is intended to give clear guidance before departure, to keep communication respectful, and to ensure that concerns are handled promptly when a disruption occurs.

For the missed connection matter, <<FACT F110>>. We want to make clear that this guidance is part of our regular service handling and is applied in accordance with the circumstances of the case. If you have supporting documents, please keep them together and submit them through the usual claim channel so the review can continue without delay.

For the crate issue, <<FACT F118>>. Please include the booking reference, the travel date, and a brief statement of what was observed so the file can be matched accurately. If the crate or any accompanying item was delayed, damaged, or not returned as expected, our team will assess the report and advise on the next steps.

Aurelia Skyways values the care of animals in transit and expects its staff and service partners to act with patience and precision. We are sorry for the distress caused to you and your companion animal, and we will use your report to reinforce the standard that travelers should receive careful guidance and timely support throughout the journey.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
